resources.string: Looking for this phone’s hotspot…
Current hotspot address: %1$s
The Tesla browser probably cannot open this address. Choose another hotspot address method below.
No hotspot found. Turn on this phone’s hotspot.
Hotspot address
Normal
Root
VPN (experimental)
Shizuku
Probably does not work on this phone
Adds no address and needs nothing. Use it for other car browsers, or when the hotspot address is already in 100.64.0.0/10. Applies at once; no reconnect needed.
Needs root. Adds %1$s to this phone’s hotspot so the Tesla browser can reach TiPlay, and adds it again after the hotspot restarts. Applies at once; no reconnect needed.

No root. Holds %1$s on a VPN that only TiPlay uses, so other apps are not affected. Android asks once to allow the VPN, and no other VPN can be on at the same time. Applies at once; no reconnect needed.

No root, but needs Shizuku running with TiPlay allowed. Start Shizuku again after every phone restart, through wireless debugging (needs Wi-Fi) or from a computer over USB. Adds %1$s to this phone’s hotspot, and adds it again after the hotspot restarts. Shizuku cannot remove it, so after you choose another method it stays until the hotspot restarts. Applies at once; no reconnect needed.
This Android version drops hotspot traffic to a VPN address, so the VPN method probably does not work on this phone. Addresses in 169.254.0.0/16 are exempt: try %1$s.
Address
An address in 100.64.0.0/10, the range the Tesla browser opens, or in 169.254.0.0/16 for the VPN method. Applies at once.
Asking for root access…
TiPlay did not get root access, so the hotspot address method did not change. Allow TiPlay in your root manager, such as Magisk, and choose Root again.
Address added to %1$s.
Waiting for this phone’s hotspot.
Root access was refused, so TiPlay stopped trying. Choose Root again to try again.
Could not add the address. TiPlay tries again shortly.
Paused. TiPlay adds the address again when it opens or connects.
Works only when the connection uses “%1$s”.
Shizuku is not running. Start it again after every phone restart, through wireless debugging (needs Wi-Fi) or from a computer over USB.
Shizuku has not allowed TiPlay yet.
Allow TiPlay in Shizuku
Shizuku did not allow TiPlay. Allow TiPlay in the Shizuku app, then come back here.
This phone does not let Shizuku change the hotspot address. Choose another method.
TiPlay cannot remove the address it added through Shizuku. It is removed when the hotspot restarts.
VPN is up with %1$s.
Starting the VPN…
Android has not allowed TiPlay’s VPN yet.
Allow the VPN
Another VPN is on. TiPlay does not replace it: turn the other VPN off, then come back here.
TiPlay’s wired CarPlay connection is using the VPN. The hotspot address VPN starts after that connection ends.
The VPN was turned off in Android settings or by another VPN app.
Could not start the VPN. TiPlay tries again when it opens or connects; if it keeps failing, choose another method.
This phone cannot show Android’s VPN permission screen.
